Most local businesses underestimate how much their site signals to prospects. A dated, cluttered, or broken experience quietly broadcasts neglect. This dental practice was thriving offline, with loyal patients and years of success, but online the story collapsed. Their WordPress build had rotted: pixelated assets, overlapping elements, broken mobile views, and a booking flow that felt impossible. The real issue was mindset. No one owned their digital presence day-to-day, so the site decayed in plain sight.

Worse, the content strategy was stuck a decade in the past. Hundreds of keyword-stuffed pages provided noise instead of value. Google now rewards clarity and genuine expertise, so the practice was effectively invisible.
- **Focus and simplicity.** Each page now drives one outcome (book, consult, or explore the smile gallery) so visitors never wonder what to do next.

A modern local business needs someone thinking about the digital funnel daily: site flows, listings on Google and Apple, ad campaigns, social proof, and fresh content.
